summary: Tested External API (bbk_ keys + POST /api/v1/chat) and configurable Knowledge Gate (strict/flexible) on backend and frontend. Backend: 15 of 16 new tests passed, and the existing strict-gate regression test_knowledge_gate.py passed 6 of 6. Key create (bbk_ + 48 hex, full key returned only on create), list (no key/key_hash/_id), v1 chat (response/session_id/instance_id, usage_count/last_used_at updated), invalid/missing/non-bbk key -> 401, disabled key -> 403, re-enable works, revoke -> later calls 401 and a second delete -> 404. Flexible mode answers the off-KB question 'capital of France' with the prefix "This isn't in my knowledge base, but from my general knowledge:" and 'Paris'. This works via both /chat/send and /v1/chat. Strict mode refuses. A KB question in flexible mode is answered from the KB. The one failure is that knowledge_gate is not validated. Frontend: the Knowledge Gate card (Strict/Flexible) saves via Save Settings and keeps the setting after reload. The API Keys card works end to end: Generate Key shows the banner with the full key, then a new row appears; toggle changes the icon state; revoke removes the row; the usage example curl is shown.

minor.issue: knowledge_gate accepts any string (for example 'bogus' -> 200). build_system_prompt treats anything other than 'strict' as flexible, so a typo silently turns on general-knowledge answers. Use Literal['strict','flexible'] in BotConfigUpdate.
Not scoped to an instance: the key is looked up by id only. This is fine today because only superadmin is allowed, but it will become an IDOR if access is opened to instance admins.

These require superadmin (require_admin), but GET only requires instance access. Non-superadmin instance users see the card and the Generate/Toggle/Revoke buttons, which fail with 403 (toggle/revoke show a generic error toast). Either hide the controls for non-superadmins or allow instance admins.
No rate limit or message length limit on a public endpoint that costs LLM money. The Bearer prefix check is case-sensitive ('bearer bbk_' is rejected).

ui_bugs.issue: Revoke deletes immediately with no confirmation dialog, and the action is permanent.
The newKeyRevealed banner is not cleared when the instance is switched, so it can show the previous instance's key.

issues: Changing the gate needs a separate 'Save Settings' click in the left panel. The helper text says so, but the user can easily miss it. Consider auto-saving the setting or showing an unsaved indicator.

action_items: Scope api-key toggle/delete by instance_id, and align the permission model between GET and the write endpoints. Hide the write controls for non-superadmins.
Add a confirmation before revoking an API key
Consider rate limiting and a max message length on /api/v1/chat
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3780 lines and should be split into routers (external_api, bot_config, knowledge, etc.)
create_api_key takes a raw dict body. Use a Pydantic model (instance_id: str, label: Optional[str])
`import hashlib` is repeated inline in two functions. Move it to a module-level import or a _hash_key helper.
/chat/send and /v1/chat share the same prompt-building and LLM-call logic. Extract a shared helper (DRY).
seed_data_creation: TEST_ keys were created and revoked during the tests (cleaned up). The pre-existing 'Test Key' is kept. knowledge_gate on instance 88bfae82 was restored to 'strict'.
